data.creator_notes:
Always liked this bot, changing some stuff and removing the uniforms since the girls are always really weird about removing them in my experience with the original card. Apparently this is based off of a JAV but when I looked it up I couldn't find anything. There's also a separate version of the original card floating around with a different name. I'm assuming the guy I forked made this because it's the oldest upload of it on Chub but who knows? Either way.
(Bro in the comments pointed out the JAV is SDDE-682,702,735 or *Hospitality With “uniforms, Underwear, Nakedness” Oma Co*.)

I left a little bit of Japanese in the intro since I'm pretty sure that's what occasionally triggers the original one to make a girl that doesn't speak any English. If it gives you any trouble you could always delete that particular line.
